materials_exhausted.note: Bounded re-review reopened primary XML/PDF, OA package NXML/PDF/supplement PDF, PDF text, locator index, packet database snapshots, and merged sequence/assay/literature rows. Local materials support the Table 1 activity/database rows and direct mechanism claims; remaining identity issues are nonblocking cautions, not missing local material.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: All 48 linked DBAASP assay/experiment rows were rechecked against primary Table 1 and method/supplement locators. Activity values match after nM-to-µM unit interpretation; one E. faecium database note conflict and two database-only chain-sequence literature identities are preserved as cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Final activity evidence now retains 24 Haloduracin rows only: 22 quantitative IC50/MIC rows from Table 1 and two qualitative Gram-negative no-inhibition agar-diffusion rows. Nisin comparator columns were checked but excluded from Haloduracin final AMP rows.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Direct mechanism evidence is limited to 1:1 synergy, sequential Halα/Halβ action, membrane depolarization, and potassium efflux assays. Likely lipid II targeting remains inferred, not direct.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_4_material_packet: XML/PDF/OA package/supplement PDF and merged rows were reopened. The empty paper/source/supplementary directory is not a blocker because the OA package contains the recoverable supplement PDF used for methods and Table S1 context.

adjudication_summary: Worker-4/worker-6 re-review closes the original source-review ticket with source-supported Haloduracin activity/database reconciliation and preserved cautions for database-only chain identity and one database note conflict.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASPR_19031/19750 sequence-name metadata are recovered from merged DBAASP sequence rows, but local primary materials do not fully normalize those chain sequences or cross-name synonyms; preserved as source_conflict, not source_verified identity.
One DBAASP IC50 row note says CRE E. faecium C33105 while primary Table 1 labels the isolate vancomycin-resistant E. faecium; activity value and isolate match, note conflict preserved.

The OA package supplement PDF was checked; it contains growth-condition Table S1, purification/methods, and supplementary figures, not a separate activity table that changes Table 1 Haloduracin activity rows.
The paper frames lipid II targeting as likely from structural/mutant context; final mechanism keeps direct claims to synergy, sequential action, membrane depolarization, and potassium efflux assays.

bounded_rework_result.note: Owner-layer re-review resolved framework-test and database-conflict blockers without fabricating unsupported source values.
